sn15.19:1.3: pubbakoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ ||
sn15.19:1.4: Na so bhikkhave satto sulabharūpo yo na dhītābhūtapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā || ||
sn15.19:1.7: pubbakoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattāhaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvatam saṃsarataṃ || ||
sn15.19:1.8: Evaṃ dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave dukkham paccanubhūtaṃ tibbaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ vyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ kaṭasivaḍḍhitā || Yavaṃ
sn15.19:1.9: cidam bhikkhave alam eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alam virajjituṃ alam vimuccitunti || ||
